effect.kaleidoscope_cookery.hinder.descr: Anything you damage is afflicted with Slowness II for 5 seconds.
effect.kaleidoscope_cookery.instant_smel: Ores you mine drop their smelted result instead of raw material.
effect.kaleidoscope_cookery.projectile_d: Incoming projectiles are negated and teleport you a short distance away. Each dodge uses up part of the effect.
effect.kaleidoscope_cookery.vitality.des: Killing a grown mob leaves behind a baby of the same kind. Grown zombies rarely leave a baby villager instead.
